readerCopy.body: An inspiring story becomes harder to accept when the power structure underneath it can no longer be ignored. When Neptune opposes Pluto, ideals and belief face control, secrecy, money, and concentrated leverage directly. The contradiction can expose the distance between what an institution says it protects and what its choices allow. A value can remain worth caring about even when the person or structure claiming to represent it has made its own motives harder to trust.
